APK Cloner builds a new, independently installable app from an APK: it rewrites the package name, the launcher label, the provider authorities and selected permissions in the binary manifest, repackages the ZIP with correct alignment, and signs the result with a key generated on this device.

What it cannot do:
• Work without the original APK: the clone contains the original app’s code and resources, unmodified.
• Keep the original signature. Google sign-in, Play Integrity, in-app billing, DRM and anything else that checks the signing certificate will fail.
• Clone split APKs / app bundles, or apps that declare a sharedUserId.
• Install without user confirmation: Android always asks.
• Keep Play Store updates. The clone is a separate app and is not updated by the store.

What it does not do:
• No code is modified or patched.
• Nothing leaves the device; the app requests no network permission.
